assignee.Description: The resource which will use the reservation. E.g. projects/myproject, folders/123, organizations/456.

job_type.Description: Types of job, which could be specified when using the reservation. Possible values: JOB_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, PIPELINE, QUERY

name.Description: Output only. The resource name of the assignment.

state.Description: Assignment will remain in PENDING state if no active capacity commitment is present. It will become ACTIVE when some capacity commitment becomes active. Possible values: STATE_UNSPECIFIED, PENDING, ACTIVE
